Hymn 328: An Angel from on High
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: John E. Tullidge
Lyricist/Text Author: Parley P. Pratt
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 328 titled "An Angel from on High" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by John E. Tullidge and the lyrics were written by Parley P. Pratt.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
